	self:UpdateDescendants(self.Folder)

	self.Folder.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
		self:UpdatePart(descendant)
	end)

	local lastState = getgenv().remover

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if getgenv().remover ~= lastState then
			lastState = getgenv().remover
			self:UpdateDescendants(self.Folder)
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function ObstacleRemove:UpdatePart(part)
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
	end

	if part.Name == "Hitbox" then
		if not self.OriginalPositions[part] then
			self.OriginalPositions[part] = part.Position
		end

		if getgenv().remover then
			part.Position = Vector3.new(0, -5000, 0)
		else
			part.Position = self.OriginalPositions[part]
		end
	end
end

function ObstacleRemove:UpdateDescendants(parent)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
		self:UpdatePart(descendant)
	end
end

	Frame.Position = UDim2.new(

		startPos.Y.Scale,
		startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Frame.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()

end)
